subject: Cadence-based commit ladder & temporary price anchor
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@lumenix.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Proposal: cadence-based commit ladder & temporary price anchor

Hi Samir —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Based on our usage patterns and your roadmap notes (spikes Q3, steady growth Q4), we sketched a pricing structure that preserves your unit economics while giving Lumenix flexibility to ramp. Attached: a short one-pager (Lumenix_commit_ladder_v1.pdf) and a workbook with the prorate examples.

High level:
- 12-month base term with three cadence checkpoints (month 3, month 6, month 9) to ladder commits up or down by pre-agreed bands.
- Temporary price anchor: hold today's host rate for 90 days from renewal signature for committed baseline volumes.
- Prorated credits: if actual consumption is below the committed band at checkpoints, credits are applied immediately; if above, overage shows at the committed per-token rate for the remainder of the quarter.

Ask: can you confirm the internal procurement calendar and whether a 90-day anchor + staged commit is acceptable? If yes, I’ll loop in Ben from pricing for a workbook walkthrough and prepare a redlineable term summary.

Best,
Dylan
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Attach: Lumenix_commit_ladder_v1.pdf, prorate_and_anchor_calcs.xlsx
From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@lumenix.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Rao <prao@lumenix.com>
Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Proposal: cadence-based commit ladder & temporary price anchor

Dylan —

Thank you. The structure looks promising. A couple of notes from our side:
- Procurement needs any price-holds to be explicitly timeboxed and tied to committed volumes; open-ended anchors won't pass legal. 90 days should be fine but we need language that ties it to the baseline commit.
- We run budget planning the first week of June. If we can sign by end of May (tight), it helps us lock Q3 budget.
- Question on credits: can the credits be used against future bursts or only against base invoices? Flexible credit usage would make this easier for us.

Can you put Ben on a short call to walk the workbook and confirm the math? Priya is on copy; she will coordinate procurement.

Samir
Samir Patel
Head of Cloud Platforms | Lumenix
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@lumenix.com>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Proposal: cadence-based commit ladder & temporary price anchor

Ben / Monica —

Looping you in after Samir's note. Key asks: 90-day timeboxed anchor tied to baseline commit; clarity on whether credits can be applied to bursts. Samir's procurement wants a clear callout in the T&Cs.

Attached workbook shows three sample cadence bands for baseline volumes (Low / Target / High) and three checkpoint months. I think a pragmatic approach is:
- Anchor = baseline signed volume at renewal X our host rate, guaranteed for 90 days.
- Credits = refundable credits that can offset base invoices and up to 50% of burst charges in the quarter (proposalable).
- Checkpoints allow +/- 20% adjustments for Low/High bands without penalty.

Can you run the workbook numbers and propose the exact credit language and a quick amendment we can send to Lumenix? Samir said they need procurement timing by the first week of June.

Thanks,
Dylan
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@lumenix.com>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 12:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Proposal: cadence-based commit ladder & temporary price anchor

All —

I ran the workbook and drafted a concise term summary. High level numbers (sample, based on Lumenix Q3 forecast):
- Baseline commit (signed): 1,200k token units / month @ $0.0008 per unit.
- 90-day anchor: floor rate = $0.0008 for baseline only. Anchor expires after 90 days from signature; any increases above baseline priced at standard host rate at time of consumption.
- Credit mechanics: if actual consumption < baseline for a checkpoint quarter, Lumenix receives a refundable credit equal to (baseline - actual) * floor rate. Credits may be applied to base invoice or up to 50% of burst/overage charges in the immediate following quarter; remaining credits carry as invoice credit for up to 12 months.
- Checkpoint band: +/- 20% on baseline without penalty. Changes beyond bands trigger reprice conversation.

Attachments: (1) Lumenix_commit_ladder_v1.pdf — narrative summary; (2) prorate_and_anchor_calcs.xlsx — line-item math.

Notes for legal: add a clause that anchor is conditional on signed baseline and no material changes in usage profile (defined as >2x variance month-to-month). Also include normal audit rights.

Samir — if this aligns, we can convert the narrative to an amendment and get a procurement-friendly cover memo. I can be on the call Monday to walk the math.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Director, Pricing & Commercial Strategy | Redwood Inference
Attach: prorate_and_anchor_calcs.xlsx
From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@lumenix.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Rao <prao@lumenix.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 15:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Proposal: cadence-based commit ladder & temporary price anchor

Dylan / Ben —

This looks good and gives the procurement language I need. Two quick confirmations before we proceed: (1) credits applied to bursts up to 50% is acceptable, (2) anchor tied to signed baseline and 90 days is acceptable. Priya will schedule our procurement call next week; we aim to sign in the last week of May if the final amendment matches the summary.

Please turn the narrative into an amendment draft we can redline. Once Priya confirms the calendar, Samir and I will be on the call to finalize.

Thanks — moving quickly on our side.

Samir
<thread-end>
